name: General ledger
short_description: The main bookkeeping record of a company that collects all financial transactions by account; in Dynamics 365 Finance it is the official home for every posted money movement.

The general ledger is the master financial record of a company and every posted transaction ends up there in some form.
In plain English, the General Ledger is a register of the company's debit and credit entries.
